dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in the 2D planar width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit smooth, symmetrical arcs without localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey-scale clusters distributed along the dorsal midline and head region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between localized grey-pixel clusters and the primary light-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, longitudinal, low-contrast linear marks on the posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle linear topological depression along the central dorsal ridge in the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear scars are visible on the posterior dorsal surface.
